sourceAuthority: T4127 Payroll Deductions Formulas — Chapter 6 (CPP), Government of Canada 2026 YBE announcement
verificationNote: Expected pay-period basic exemption values derive directly from CRA formula PPBE = ybe / P using the CRA-authoritative YBE ($3,500.00) and the ACTUAL calendar-period count P (§5 rule — 52/53, 26/27, 24, or 12). These are CRA-formula derivations, not Spectre-calculator outputs.

cases.description: Weekly Pay Group with 52 pay dates in the tax year.
cases.notes: 3500 / 52 = 67.30769230769... Kept unrounded in the intermediate; the deduction line rounds to nearest cent.

cases.description: Weekly Pay Group with 53 pay dates in the tax year (a leap-week year).
cases.notes: 3500 / 53 = 66.03773584905... — a 53-week year produces a different PPBE than a 52-week year. Hard-coding 52 would be WRONG.
